We requested special dishes for our kid, gujarati vegetarian meals&dinner and even though we were not in Dadar at first, her delivery service was very fast and delivered the food at the door of our hotel in Marine drive & the other days wherever we were in the sightseeing tours!!! Easy communication and the food is so good that we went specially to meet her in Dadar where we enjoyed in her home, not only her food but her company and lovely family. Clean place & Anjali is like a mother outside your home!!! I cant thank you enough for everything and your hospitality.  You cant leave Mumbai without ordering from Lokhande Tiffin! We will definely come back as soon as we have holidays again!🙏🏽

featured_reviews.review_text: I recently tried Lokhande Tiffin Service, and I must say, it's one of the best food experiences I've had! Not only does she prepare home-cooked, flavorful meals, but she also takes orders for birthday parties and small gatherings. If you're looking for tasty, fresh, and homemade food, I highly recommend visiting her service. The quality is unmatched, and you can really taste the care that goes into every dish! 😇🥰

The meal which is priced quite economically at 120rs inclusive of home delivery charges comes in plastic containers and rotis in safe and nice packing. The meal had a portion of white rice which were of good quality which is hard to find such tiffin services, a container portion of dal which was plain with mild tadka and just the kind you would expect at home that suits all taste buds, rotis were typical sindhi style that is very soft with a touch of oil and last was the paneer capsicum which was mildly dry and had onion in it too.

I've been availing their services since June 2024 and am a delighted customer.

I can't praise them enough. Great food, great service and a delight!
